headline: Delta State Receives Highest FAAC Allocation in Nigeria at N98.27 Billion
summary: Delta State secured the largest net allocation among Nigeria's 36 states in August, receiving N98.27 billion from the Federation Account Allocation Committee as Lagos fell to fifth place.
why: FAAC revenue shares distribute Nigeria's oil and tax revenues among the three tiers of government, directly driving state-level public finances and local economic activity.
